actions.create_record_ai.description: Adds a record to a Teable table using field names.
actions.create_record_ai.props.baseId.de: The Teable base ID. Get it from List Bases.
actions.create_record_ai.props.fields.de: A JSON object keyed by field name or field ID, e.g. {"Name": "Jane", "Age": 30, "Status": "Open"}. Select fields take the option name; link and user fields take names or IDs.
actions.create_record_ai.props.table.des: The table name or table ID. Get both from Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_base_schema_ai.description: Gets every table and field in a Teable base.
The Teable base ID. Get it from List Bases.
actions.search_records_ai.description: Finds records in a Teable table by text or field values.
actions.search_records_ai.props.baseId.d: The Teable base ID. Get it from List Bases.
Exact matches keyed by field name or ID; all conditions must match.
actions.search_records_ai.props.limit.de: The maximum number of records to return (1-1000).
actions.search_records_ai.props.search.d: Only return records containing this text in any field.
actions.search_records_ai.props.table.de: The table name or table ID. Get both from Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.teable_add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a record.
actions.teable_add_comment.props.record_: The record to act on. Shows the first 1000 records; pass a record ID directly for larger tables.
actions.teable_add_comment.props.table_i: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_create_field.description: Adds a new field (column) to a table.
actions.teable_create_field.props.name.d: The name of the new field. Must be unique within the table.
actions.teable_create_field.props.option: Type-specific options as JSON. See the Teable field documentation.
actions.teable_create_field.props.table_: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_create_record.description: Creates a new record in a Teable table.
actions.teable_create_record.props.field: The fields to set on the record.
actions.teable_create_record.props.table: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_create_records.descriptio: Creates multiple records in a Teable table in one call.
actions.teable_create_records.props.reco: A JSON array of records, each an object keyed by field name.
actions.teable_create_records.props.tabl: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_create_table.description: Creates a new table in a base.
actions.teable_create_table.props.name.d: The name of the new table.
actions.teable_delete_record.description: Deletes a record from a Teable table by its ID.
actions.teable_delete_record.props.recor: The record to act on. Shows the first 1000 records; pass a record ID directly for larger tables.
actions.teable_delete_record.props.table: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_delete_records.descriptio: Permanently deletes multiple records from a Teable table by their IDs.
actions.teable_delete_records.props.reco: The IDs of the records to delete.
actions.teable_delete_records.props.tabl: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_get_record.description: Retrieves a single record from a table by its ID.
actions.teable_get_record.props.cellForm: The format of the cell values in the response.
actions.teable_get_record.props.record_i: The record to act on. Shows the first 1000 records; pass a record ID directly for larger tables.
actions.teable_get_record.props.table_id: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_list_bases.description: Lists all bases the connection has access to.
actions.teable_list_fields.description: Lists all fields of a table.
actions.teable_list_fields.props.table_i: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_list_records.description: Retrieves records from a table with optional filtering, search, and sorting, paging through results automatically.
actions.teable_list_records.props.cellFo: The format of the cell values in the response.
actions.teable_list_records.props.filter: A filter expression for the records. Use the visual query builder at https://app.teable.ai/developer/tool/query-builder to build one.
actions.teable_list_records.props.orderB: A JSON array of sort conditions.
actions.teable_list_records.props.search: Only return records containing this text in any field.
actions.teable_list_records.props.select: Only return the records with these IDs.
actions.teable_list_records.props.skip.d: The number of records to skip before collecting results.
actions.teable_list_records.props.table_: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_list_records.props.take.d: The maximum number of records to return (1-5000). The action pages through the table automatically.
actions.teable_list_records.props.view_i: Only return records visible in this view.
actions.teable_list_tables.description: Lists all tables in a base.
actions.teable_list_views.description: Lists all views of a table.
actions.teable_list_views.props.table_id: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_update_record.description: Updates an existing record in a Teable table.
actions.teable_update_record.props.field: The fields to set on the record.
Fields whose value should be removed from the record.
actions.teable_update_record.props.recor: The record to act on. Shows the first 1000 records; pass a record ID directly for larger tables.
actions.teable_update_record.props.table: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_update_records.descriptio: Updates multiple records in a Teable table in one call.
actions.teable_update_records.props.reco: A JSON array of updates with record IDs; a null field value clears it.
actions.teable_update_records.props.tabl: The table inside the selected base.
actions.teable_upload_attachment.descrip: Uploads a file as an attachment to a field in a Teable record.
actions.teable_upload_attachment.props.f: The attachment field to upload the file to.
The file to upload. Accepts a URL or a binary file.
actions.teable_upload_attachment.props.r: The record to act on. Shows the first 1000 records; pass a record ID directly for larger tables.
actions.teable_upload_attachment.props.t: The table inside the selected base.
actions.update_record_ai.description: Changes some fields of a Teable record using field names.
actions.update_record_ai.props.baseId.de: The Teable base ID. Get it from List Bases.
actions.update_record_ai.props.fields.de: A JSON object keyed by field name or field ID, e.g. {"Name": "Jane", "Age": 30, "Status": "Open"}. Select fields take the option name; link and user fields take names or IDs.
The ID of the record, e.g. from Search Records (Agent).
actions.update_record_ai.props.table.des: The table name or table ID. Get both from Get Base Schema (Agent).
actions.upsert_record_ai.description: Updates the record whose key field matches, or creates it.
actions.upsert_record_ai.props.baseId.de: The Teable base ID. Get it from List Bases.
actions.upsert_record_ai.props.fields.de: A JSON object keyed by field name or field ID, e.g. {"Name": "Jane", "Age": 30, "Status": "Open"}. Select fields take the option name; link and user fields take names or IDs.
actions.upsert_record_ai.props.keyColumn: The field that identifies the record, e.g. Email.
actions.upsert_record_ai.props.table.des: The table name or table ID. Get both from Get Base Schema (Agent).
triggers.teable_new_record.description: Triggers when a new record is created in a table.
triggers.teable_new_record.props.table_i: The table inside the selected base.
triggers.teable_updated_record.descripti: Triggers when a record is created or modified. The table must have a "Last modified time" field that shows the time.
triggers.teable_updated_record.props.tab: The table inside the selected base.
